company.name: Wolfia
company.shortDescription: Wolfia helps modern companies accelerate security reviews, helping close deals faster using generative AI.
company.description: Wolfia helps modern companies accelerate security reviews, helping close deals faster using generative AI. Fast growing companies like CircleCI, Solve Intelligence, and, Leya use Wolfia to accelerate their sales cycles and unblock deals. Wolfia has raised capital from top-tier investors such as Khosla Ventures, Y Combinator, PageOne VC and Twenty Two Ventures who also invested in Stripe, Airbnb, and OpenAI.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered assistant that learns from a company's internal knowledge to provide instant, expert-level answers to sales and security questions, automating repetitive tasks like questionnaires and RFP responses.
productsAndServices.name: Wolfia AI Agent

productsAndServices.description: A service that automates the completion of security questionnaires by extracting and applying verified company knowledge to answer repetitive security review questions rapidly and consistently.
productsAndServices.name: Security Questionnaire Automation

productsAndServices.description: A tool that automatically drafts detailed responses to Request for Proposals (RFPs) by leveraging a company's existing knowledge base, improving response speed and consistency.
productsAndServices.name: RFP Response Automation

productsAndServices.description: A platform that consolidates and presents a company's AI security and compliance documentation transparently to enterprise buyers, facilitating faster security reviews and deal closures.
productsAndServices.name: Wolfia AI Trust Center

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,663,704 to $5,663,704, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 90 (+80 over 90 days) and market heat at 73 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Loopio, Responsive, RFP360.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
